cac34793fb4040.s:
With reference to the UPSC, consider the following statements:
1. The UPSC headquarters is at Metcalfe House, Delhi.
2. The first Public Service Commission was set up at Metcalfe House, Delhi.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cac34793fb4040.x: Only 2 is correct: the first Public Service Commission was set up at Metcalfe House, Delhi. The UPSC headquarters is at Dholpur House, New Delhi.

ca82c8ec89d386.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Assam Rifles is administered by the Army and operates under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
2. Article 33 empowers Parliament to restrict the Fundamental Rights of members of the forces.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca82c8ec89d386.x: Only 2 is correct. The Assam Rifles is administratively under the Ministry of Home Affairs and operationally under the Army, so statement 1 reverses the roles.

ca4e85a2c16d3f.s:
Assertion (A): World Mental Health Day is observed every year on 10 October.
Reason (R): World Mental Health Day was first observed in 1992.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ca4e85a2c16d3f.x: Both are true: the day falls on 10 October and was first observed in 1992, but the year of its first observance does not explain the date chosen.

cafb21d3b30922.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
cafb21d3b30922.x: Article 371F relates to Sikkim. Article 371A is for Nagaland, 371D for Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, and 371J for Karnataka.

caaedc28ab376b.s: Which of the following pairs (force – year of establishment) is correctly matched?
caaedc28ab376b.x: CRPF was established in 1939. BSF dates to 1965 and CISF to 1969.

ca2551a7d7fffd.s: Which organisation became the 46th terrorist organisation in the First Schedule of the UAPA, 1967 on September 16, 2026?
ca2551a7d7fffd.x: The MHA declared the Pakistan-based Shehzad Bhatti Network a terrorist organisation under the UAPA, making it the 46th in the First Schedule.

cabc4715cf9e6d.s:
With reference to the Prevention of Insults to National Honour (Amendment) Act, 2026, consider the following statements:
1. It extends anthem-level protection to Vande Mataram.
2. It received Presidential assent on September 6, 2026.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cabc4715cf9e6d.x: Only 1 is correct: the Act extends anthem-level protection to Vande Mataram. Presidential assent was given on August 6, 2026.

ca25c4acdd972a.s: NavIC (earlier IRNSS), developed after GPS data was denied during the Kargil War, carries which type of clocks?
ca25c4acdd972a.x: NavIC, earlier IRNSS, was developed after GPS data was denied during the Kargil War and carries atomic clocks.

caab11064a0082.s: The Registration of Births and Deaths (Amendment) Act, 2026 came into force on:
caab11064a0082.x: The Act came into force on October 1, 2026; it had received Presidential assent in August 2026.

ca31c858b05d3f.s:
With reference to the Gujarat Uniform Civil Code Bill–2026, consider the following statements:
1. It covers marriage, divorce and inheritance but excludes live-in relationships.
2. The Uniform Civil Code is mentioned in Article 44 in Part IV of the Constitution.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca31c858b05d3f.x: Only 2 is correct: Article 44 (Part IV, DPSP) deals with the UCC. The Bill also covers live-in relationships.

ca0a57ef1308da.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Article 44, a Directive Principle in Part IV, directs the State to endeavour to secure a Uniform Civil Code.
2. Article 25 deals with freedom of religion.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca0a57ef1308da.x: Both are correct: Article 44 in Part IV concerns the Uniform Civil Code and Article 25 concerns religion.

ca73bee7e68660.s: Which statement on State-level Uniform Civil Code measures (September 2026 debate) is correct?
o: Uttarakhand UCC in force since January 2024; Assam, Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh Bills await Presidential assent
Uttarakhand UCC in force since January 2025; Assam, Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh Bills await Presidential assent
Uttarakhand UCC in force since January 2025; Assam, Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh Bills have received Presidential assent
Uttarakhand UCC in force since January 2025; Assam, Gujarat and Rajasthan Bills await Presidential assent
ca73bee7e68660.x: Uttarakhand's UCC has been in force since January 2025, while the Bills of Assam, Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh await Presidential assent.

ca7834e580d103.s: Which of the following pairs (case – legal point) is correctly matched?
o: Shayara Bano – Goa as an example of a common civil code
Jose Paulo Coutinho – Instant triple talaq invalid
Shayara Bano – Casteism and gender discrimination cannot claim Article 29 protection
Section 6A Citizenship Act case, 2024 – Casteism and gender discrimination cannot claim Article 29 protection
ca7834e580d103.x: The Section 6A case (2024) held that casteism and gender discrimination cannot claim Article 29 protection. Shayara Bano invalidated instant triple talaq and Jose Paulo Coutinho cited Goa's common civil code.

cac0a89bc5d3eb.s: Which of the following about the Supreme Court's power under Article 142 is NOT correct?
o: It is a power of the Supreme Court.
It is unlimited and can override fundamental constitutional limits.
It cannot override fundamental constitutional limits.
cac0a89bc5d3eb.x: Article 142 is broad but not unlimited; it cannot override fundamental constitutional limits, so the claim that it is unlimited is false.

ca450cb392a38b.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. High Courts also possess the power under Article 142 to do complete justice.
2. Article 142(2) deals with constitutional remedies and is called the heart and soul of the Constitution.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca450cb392a38b.x: Both are wrong: Article 142 power belongs only to the Supreme Court, and Article 142(2) concerns attendance, documents and contempt; 'heart and soul' refers to Article 32.

ca17426df94301.s: Which service did the Supreme Court launch on Hindi Diwas, September 14, 2026, to make its judgments easier to understand?
ca17426df94301.x: The Supreme Court launched Jan Suchna Seva, offering simplified judgments and 15–30 minute audio-visual explainers.

cab5203419d3db.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. For remand, written grounds of arrest must be supplied at least 2 hours before production; otherwise the arrest is illegal.
2. Section 47 of the BNSS requires informing the arrested person of the grounds and bail rights.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cab5203419d3db.x: Both are correct: the ruling requires written grounds at least 2 hours before production, and Section 47 BNSS covers communication of grounds and bail rights.

cae2946e156cf8.s: Under the ruling on written grounds of arrest, re-arresting a person requires the permission of the:
cae2946e156cf8.x: Re-arrest requires written grounds and the permission of a Judicial Magistrate; the probe must also go to another officer.

ca767910ac0eaf.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Under Paragraph 6 of the Tenth Schedule, the Speaker decides disqualification cases, subject to judicial review.
2. Under Article 192, the Governor decides disqualification cases arising under the Tenth Schedule.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca767910ac0eaf.x: Only 1 is correct: Paragraph 6 gives the decision to the Speaker, subject to judicial review. Article 192 concerns other disqualifications.

ca4b1d70c25547.s: Who chairs the Zonal Councils set up under the States Reorganisation Act, 1956?
ca4b1d70c25547.x: The Union Home Minister chairs the Zonal Councils; Chief Ministers serve as Vice-Chairmen by rotation.

ca544fccbadaf8.s: Which of the following pairs (time-dissemination technology – accuracy) is correctly matched?
ca544fccbadaf8.x: PTP gives microsecond accuracy. NTP gives milliseconds, satellite links nanoseconds and optical links picoseconds.

ca355a95ddf208.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship was established in 2014.
2. The Skill India Mission was launched in 2016.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca355a95ddf208.x: Only 1 is correct: MSDE dates to 2014. The Skill India Mission was launched in 2015.

cabbd9e9d58918.s:
With reference to the fisheries sector, consider the following statements:
1. The sector has 2,195 FFPOs and 100 Climate Resilient Coastal Fishermen Villages.
2. PM-MKSSY is a Centrally Sponsored sub-scheme.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cabbd9e9d58918.x: Only 1 is correct. PM-MKSSY is a Central Sector sub-scheme (2023–24 to 2026–27).

cabbd48f189545.s: With reference to PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Convergence mechanism – Focus on low productivity, cropping intensity and credit
Selection of 100 districts – Convergence of 36 schemes of 11 Ministries
Nodal ministry – Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
Nodal ministry – Convergence of 36 schemes of 11 Ministries
cabbd48f189545.x: The scheme is administered by the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare; it converges 36 schemes of 11 Ministries and selects districts on low productivity, cropping intensity and credit.

ca9a4d5fcc6f8c.s: PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana was launched on:
ca9a4d5fcc6f8c.x: The scheme was launched on 11 October 2025; 16 July 2025 was the date of Cabinet approval.

ca8fb06b294039.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. India released 125 biofortified varieties during 2014–2024.
2. Iron pearl millet is an example of biofortification in India.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca8fb06b294039.x: Only 2 is correct: iron pearl millet is an Indian example. India recorded 152 biofortified varieties during 2014–2024.

ca107a75621277.s: India's fish production in 2024–25, as reported in the PMMSY comparison, was:
ca107a75621277.x: Fish production rose to 197.75 lakh tonnes in 2024–25 from 141.64 lakh tonnes in 2019–20.

cadd16ccfb0253.s: Which of the following about Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is NOT correct?
o: It is implemented by the National Health Authority.
It comes under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
The Ministry of MSME is its implementing ministry.
It provides cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year.
cadd16ccfb0253.x: PM-JAY is implemented by the National Health Authority under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare; the Ministry of MSME is linked to PM Vishwakarma.

ca08edc2b0a54f.s: The PM SHRI scheme (2022–23 to 2026–27) has a total cost of ₹27,360 crore. What is its central share?
ca08edc2b0a54f.x: Of the ₹27,360 crore total cost of PM SHRI, ₹18,128 crore is the central share.

caf2a158d6d6f3.s: The National Circular Bioenergy Scheme (GOBARdhan) aims to raise Compressed Biogas (CBG) output approximately:
caf2a158d6d6f3.x: The scheme aims to raise CBG output approximately ten-fold.

cab7c6223d1014.s: With reference to the Swachh Bharat Mission, which pair is correctly matched?
o: ODF Plus villages at the Model stage – 2.25 lakh+
cab7c6223d1014.x: The SBM logo is Gandhi's spectacles. SBM was launched on October 2, 2014, rural India became ODF in 2019, and 5.25 lakh+ villages are ODF Plus Model.

n75195f4a84c.x: The scheme covers 100 low-productivity districts for six years and is expected to benefit about 1.7 crore farmers.

ca82856b3b3800.s: Which statement about the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) is correct?
o: Set up in 1911 as ICMR; renamed IRFA in 1949; under the Department of Health Research
Set up in 1949 as IRFA; renamed ICMR in 1956; under the Department of Higher Education
Set up in 1911 as IRFA; renamed ICMR in 1949; under the Department of Health Research
Set up in 1965 as IRFA; renamed ICMR in 2006; under the Department of Health Research
ca82856b3b3800.x: ICMR was established in 1911 as IRFA, renamed ICMR in 1949, and functions under the Department of Health Research.

ca334fb42e8b5f.s: Which is the world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme, giving ₹5 lakh per family per year?
ca334fb42e8b5f.x: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme, with ₹5 lakh cover per family per year.

ca20d53a4c8a9a.s:
With reference to Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, consider the following statements:
1. As on 23 September 2026, 48.54 crore Ayushman Cards had been issued.
2. It provides cashless and paperless cover for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca20d53a4c8a9a.x: Both are correct: 48.54 crore Ayushman Cards had been issued by 23 September 2026, and the scheme gives cashless, paperless secondary and tertiary hospitalisation cover.

ca4eda016efb9a.s: With reference to rice fortification, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Fortification of all custom-milled rice in specified schemes – 2018
Extension of the rice-fortification programme – March 2024
Pilot with iron, folic acid and vitamin B12 – 2019
ca4eda016efb9a.x: The pilot dates to 2019. Anemia Mukt Bharat is from 2018, full custom-milled rice coverage from March 2024, and the extension runs till December 2028.

ca61fdbdaf9cb4.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. India's target to eliminate Hepatitis B and C as public-health threats is aligned with SDG 3.2.
2. Hepatitis B has a vaccine, whereas Hepatitis C has no vaccine and is treated with antivirals.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca61fdbdaf9cb4.x: Only 2 is correct. The elimination target is aligned with SDG 3.3, not SDG 3.2.

ca11a26d48dca8.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. NIPUN Bharat targets foundational literacy and numeracy by Grade 2 by 2025–26.
2. ULLAS is meant for adults aged 15 years and above.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca11a26d48dca8.x: Only 2 is correct: ULLAS covers adults aged 15+. NIPUN Bharat's target year is 2026–27.

caaf5ed9b7c5e1.s: Which of the following about the 9th Rashtriya Poshan Maah 2026 is NOT correct?
o: It was launched on September 9, 2026 at the Rudraksh International Cooperation and Convention Centre, Varanasi.
It was launched from Dhar, Madhya Pradesh.
Its theme was 'Hamari Anganwadi, Hamari Jimmedari'.
Its Home Visit Scheduler tracks 34 developmental milestones for children up to 3 years.
caaf5ed9b7c5e1.x: The 9th Poshan Maah was launched in Varanasi; Dhar, Madhya Pradesh was associated with the 8th Poshan Maah in 2025.

ca80e9348010fa.s: With reference to AISHE 2023–24, which pair is correctly matched?
ca80e9348010fa.x: Total enrolment in 2023–24 was 4.50 crore; there were 1,289 universities, 48,246 colleges and 3.43 lakh PhD enrolments.

ca226d0ccef5a3.s: With reference to AISHE 2023–24, which pair is correctly matched?
ca226d0ccef5a3.x: Female GER was 31.2%, higher than male GER of 28.9%; female enrolment was 2.24 crore and STEM enrolment 1.02 crore.

ca83cdd58b6ff5.s: Which of the following about the FSSAI 'Eat Right Place of Worship' certification for the Ayodhya Ram Temple is NOT correct?
o: It was awarded to Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra, Ayodhya.
It falls under the 'Eat Right Place of Worship' initiative.
It is valid for three years.
ca83cdd58b6ff5.x: The certification is valid for two years, till 10 October 2028, not three years.

ca236dbcebc47c.s: Tamil Nadu's 'Vetri Payanam Thittam', offering zero-fare travel on ordinary town buses, means:
ca236dbcebc47c.x: 'Vetri Payanam Thittam' means 'Journey to Success Scheme'; it offers zero-fare travel to women, non-binary and transgender persons.

caf496ebc36d7d.s: The University Grants Commission (UGC) is a statutory body established under the:
caf496ebc36d7d.x: The UGC is a statutory body set up under the UGC Act, 1956.

ca4102cfb6549f.s: Birkbeck, University of London received the UGC Letter of Approval in September 2026 for a campus in:
ca4102cfb6549f.x: Birkbeck, University of London got the UGC Letter of Approval for its Bengaluru campus, the final regulatory step.

ca4542c4b5c94d.s: Who launched the Ayurvarta digital discussion series on September 1, 2026?
o: Central Council for Research in Ayurvedic Sciences
All India Institute of Ayurveda, New Delhi
ca4542c4b5c94d.x: The All India Institute of Ayurveda, New Delhi launched Ayurvarta on September 1, 2026.

ca2968f20adaf2.s: Who heads the 31-member Joint Parliamentary Committee on the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026?
ca2968f20adaf2.x: Sanjay Jaiswal chairs the 31-member JPC (21 Lok Sabha and 10 Rajya Sabha members).

cad2a454022157.s: Who released the strategic action plan Mission Rangeen Machhli–2031 at Agatti, Lakshadweep?
cad2a454022157.x: The Vice-President released Mission Rangeen Machhli–2031 for ornamental fisheries at Agatti, Lakshadweep.

caf3cea2e75104.s: Which State opposed the Pamba–Achankovil–Vaippar river-linking project over possible harm to the Vembanad wetland?
caf3cea2e75104.x: Kerala opposed the Pamba–Achankovil–Vaippar link, citing possible harm to the Vembanad wetland.

cab76b6eff4d28.s: Which of the following pairs (project – detail) is correctly matched?
o: Krishna Water Supply – Water to Hyderabad
Indira Gandhi Canal – Periyar in Kerala to Vaigai in Tamil Nadu
cab76b6eff4d28.x: The Krishna Water Supply project supplies water to Hyderabad. Mullaperiyar diverts Periyar to Vaigai, and the Indira Gandhi Canal takes Sutlej–Beas water to Rajasthan.

cadca7a973750d.s: Which State became the first to introduce a dedicated comprehensive elderly care bill?
cadca7a973750d.x: Kerala became the first State with a dedicated comprehensive elderly care bill.

ca79224826e9b9.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Narcotics Control Bureau – 2020; Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan – 2020; Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
International Day Against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking – Directive Principle
ca79224826e9b9.x: Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan began in 2020 under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. The NCB dates to 1986 (MHA), Article 47 is a Directive Principle, and the international day is June 26.

ca19093aeb0beb.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Kharif crops are sown in winter, harvested in spring, and wheat is their principal cereal.
2. Rabi crops are sown with the southwest monsoon, harvested in autumn, and rice is their principal cereal.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca19093aeb0beb.x: Both are wrong: Kharif crops are sown with the southwest monsoon (rice), while Rabi crops are sown in winter and harvested in spring (wheat).

ca64236c6c1cb9.s: After the RBI's October 2026 policy, which pair is correctly matched?
ca64236c6c1cb9.x: MSF/Bank Rate stood at 5.75%, with the repo rate at 5.50% and the SDF at 5.25%.

ca62b04e2b98bd.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: NIPL – NPCI subsidiary taking UPI and RuPay abroad
ca62b04e2b98bd.x: NIPL is the NPCI subsidiary taking UPI and RuPay abroad. UPI was introduced in 2016 by NPCI and is regulated by the RBI.

caec22151127c1.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Routes for FDI – Automatic and Government
caec22151127c1.x: FDI comes through the Automatic and Government routes. FDI policy is handled by DPIIT and the RBI is headquartered in Mumbai.

ca2a8af6239b1e.s: What annual target for international medical value tourists was set at the Sanjeevani–2026 Expo (New Delhi, September 7, 2026)?
ca2a8af6239b1e.x: The target is 10 million international medical value tourists a year; about 3.5 million foreign patients were treated over the past 7 years.

ca5a622caa0ec7.s:
With reference to the IMF World Economic Outlook, October 2026, consider the following statements:
1. India's FY 2026–27 growth projection was revised from 7.0% to 6.4%.
2. Domestic demand and services were identified as growth drivers.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca5a622caa0ec7.x: Only 2 is correct: the projection was raised from 6.4% to 7.0%, not lowered, with domestic demand and services as drivers.

ca0f0db4e8ac8a.s: Who was the President of the World Bank in October 2026?
ca0f0db4e8ac8a.x: Ajay Banga was the World Bank President; Sanjay Malhotra was the RBI Governor.

ca26cea49cef27.s: The Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses was launched in:
ca26cea49cef27.x: The Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses was launched in 2025.

caee0ecbb6afb5.s: What real GDP growth did the World Bank forecast for India for FY 2026–27?
caee0ecbb6afb5.x: The World Bank raised its FY 2026–27 forecast to 7.1% from 6.6% in April 2026; 7.8% was first-quarter growth.

ca3034643815a3.s:
With reference to the new national accounts series, consider the following statements:
1. It uses 2011–12 as its base year.
2. It includes the Output Producer Price Index, IIP and Banking Services Price Index.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca3034643815a3.x: Only 2 is correct: the new series uses 2022–23 as the base year, replacing 2011–12.

ca5e04911ec46a.s: Which statement about GDP concepts in National Accounts Statistics 2026 is correct?
o: Real and nominal GDP both at constant prices; GDP = GVA + product taxes + product subsidies
Real GDP at current prices, nominal GDP at constant prices; GDP = GVA − product taxes + product subsidies
Real GDP at constant prices, nominal GDP at current prices; GDP = GVA + product taxes − product subsidies
Real and nominal GDP both at current prices; GDP = GVA − product taxes − product subsidies
ca5e04911ec46a.x: Real GDP is at constant prices and nominal GDP at current prices; GDP = GVA plus product taxes minus product subsidies.

caef7ab118e99e.s: Which of the following pairs (bank – detail) is correctly matched?
caef7ab118e99e.x: DBS Bank is based in Singapore (founded 1968); SBI dates to July 1, 1955 and is headquartered in Mumbai.

ca02c57b305e0b.s: The Global Fintech Fest 2026, held in Mumbai from 8–11 September 2026, was its:
ca02c57b305e0b.x: GFF 2026 was the 7th edition; the event began in 2020.

cae636249945d8.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The DPDP Act was enacted in 2023 and the DPDP Rules were issued in 2025.
2. The cyber helpline is 1930, while the SACHET portal concerns illegal deposits.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cae636249945d8.x: Both are correct: DPDP Act 2023 and Rules 2025; 1930 is the cyber helpline and SACHET deals with illegal deposits.

ca00501a318105.s: With reference to India's maritime sector, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Ships in the fleet in mid-2026 – 217
Share of maritime trade by value – 95%
Exclusive Economic Zone – 1.4 million sq km
ca00501a318105.x: Maritime trade carries 95% of India's trade by value. There are 217 non-major ports, a 2.4 million sq km EEZ and 1,609 ships.

ca190561b4a30c.s: In the foreign-exchange reserve ranking, which pair is correctly matched?
ca190561b4a30c.x: India ranked fourth, after China (1), Japan (2) and Switzerland (3).

ca3b6ce64a1939.s:
With reference to the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), consider the following statements:
1. It was established in 2008 in Mumbai.
2. Dilip Asbe is its MD and CEO.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca3b6ce64a1939.x: Both are correct: NPCI was set up in 2008 in Mumbai and Dilip Asbe is its MD and CEO.

ca244673198de1.s: Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs), such as the SME Growth Fund, are regulated by SEBI under the:
ca244673198de1.x: AIFs are regulated by SEBI under the SEBI (AIF) Regulations, 2012, which provide for Category I, II and III funds.

ca2a42824d0051.s: ECLGS 5.0 facilitates additional credit through guarantees of up to:
ca2a42824d0051.x: ECLGS 5.0 facilitates additional credit of up to ₹2.55 lakh crore.

ca472920d48deb.s:
With reference to ECLGS, consider the following statements:
1. Phase 5.0 addressed external disruptions and covered MSMEs, non-MSMEs and airlines.
2. The earlier phases of ECLGS ended in 2024.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca472920d48deb.x: Only 1 is correct: Phase 5.0 covers MSMEs, non-MSMEs and airlines hit by external disruptions. The earlier phases ended in 2023.

ca3e7a523166f9.s: The National Food Security Act, 2013 covers approximately:
ca3e7a523166f9.x: The NFSA, 2013 covers approximately 80 crore people.

cacc4b9a866c15.s:
With reference to systems run by NPCI, consider the following statements:
1. UPI, RuPay, IMPS and NACH are NPCI systems.
2. AePS, APBS, NFS and NETC FASTag are NPCI systems.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cacc4b9a866c15.x: Both are correct: NPCI runs UPI, RuPay, IMPS and NACH as well as AePS, APBS, NFS and NETC FASTag.

ca9fa64a65dc09.s:
With reference to the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan, consider the following statements:
1. It was launched by PM Modi on 13 October 2021.
2. Its GIS platform connects 56 Central Ministries and all 36 States and UTs.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca9fa64a65dc09.x: Only 1 is correct: it was launched on 13 October 2021. The GIS platform connects 58 Central Ministries, not 56.

caf67dcec768e1.s: Which steel-sector organisation was established in 1967 and is headquartered in Brussels?
caf67dcec768e1.x: worldsteel was established in 1967 and is headquartered in Brussels; SAIL dates to 1973.

ca7fa30885495e.s:
With reference to India Cine Hub, consider the following statements:
1. It is managed by the National Film Development Corporation, set up in 1975.
2. It offers foreign productions incentives of up to 40% of qualifying spend.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca7fa30885495e.x: Both are correct: India Cine Hub is run by NFDC (1975) and offers up to 40% of qualifying spend to foreign productions.

cae24e75c21522.s: Which GI-tagged pulse from Karnataka was reported to be in demand in the Maldives?
cae24e75c21522.x: GI Kalaburagi Tur Dal from Karnataka was in demand in the Maldives, fetching up to 30% higher prices.

cae0e4bab77144.s: During PM Modi's three-day visit, India concluded agreements on migration and mobility and young professionals exchange with which leader?
cae0e4bab77144.x: The agreements were concluded with Swiss President Guy Parmelin; Mark Carney is Canada's Prime Minister.

ca045434750d52.s: In the context of the 2nd India–EFTA Prosperity Summit 2026, which pair is correctly matched?
o: India–EFTA TEPA – Marked the first anniversary of TEPA
2nd Prosperity Summit – India's first FTA with a bloc of four developed European countries
Switzerland – Established in 1960 with headquarters at Geneva
EFTA – Established in 1960 with headquarters at Geneva
ca045434750d52.x: EFTA was established in 1960 and is headquartered at Geneva. TEPA is India's first FTA with a bloc of four developed European countries, and the summit marked its first anniversary.

cacacb8fc505db.s: Which of the following pairs (US immigration pathway – nature) is correctly matched?
o: PERM – Labour certification by the Department of Labor
Green Card – Temporary work status for up to 6 years
H-1B – Labour certification by the Department of Labor
cacacb8fc505db.x: PERM is a labour certification by the Department of Labor. H-1B is temporary work status (up to 6 years) and a Green Card is permanent residence.

ca3768b7d2c505.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Visegrád Group was formed in 1991 at Visegrád in Hungary and comprises the Czech Republic, Hungary, Poland and Slovakia.
2. The UN Security Council has 15 members: 5 permanent and 10 non-permanent members with 2-year terms.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca3768b7d2c505.x: Both are correct: the Visegrád Group (1991) has these four members, and the UNSC has 5 permanent and 10 non-permanent members with 2-year terms.

ca504223f94e36.s: What penalty did the Algerian Parliament approve for deliberately setting destructive forest fires?
o: Heavy fine with confiscation of property
ca504223f94e36.x: The Algerian Parliament approved the death penalty for deliberately setting destructive forest fires.

ca6f48f26ba3cc.s: Who represented Wales in signing the joint memorandum on constitutional change in Cardiff on September 14, 2026?
ca6f48f26ba3cc.x: Rhun ap Iorwerth represented Wales; John Swinney signed for Scotland and Michelle O'Neill for Northern Ireland.

ca130c4269839d.s:
With reference to the UNGA declaration on sea-level rise, consider the following statements:
1. Australia and New Zealand were the co-facilitators of the process.
2. The declaration called for adaptation and loss-and-damage finance.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca130c4269839d.x: Only 2 is correct. The co-facilitators were Australia and Cabo Verde, not New Zealand.

caf83d19d9663f.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The World Bank Global Economic Prospects reported growth stabilising, led by Europe and North America.
2. The IPCC special report focused on extreme-weather attribution and reduced adaptation finance.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caf83d19d9663f.x: Both are wrong: growth was stabilising under the lead of South and Southeast Asia, and the IPCC report called for more, not less, adaptation finance.

ca12a358beead2.s:
With reference to India's 2026 BRICS Chairship, consider the following statements:
1. India assumed its fifth BRICS Chairship from January 1, 2026.
2. Its theme is 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca12a358beead2.x: Only 2 is correct: the theme is 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'. The 2026 Chairship is India's fourth, not fifth.

ca73d318b90a87.s: Which pair (year of India's BRICS Chairship – event) is correctly matched?
o: 2016 – 8th summit in Goa with BRICS–BIMSTEC outreach
2021 – 4th summit in New Delhi with the Delhi Declaration
ca73d318b90a87.x: India's 2016 Chairship featured the 8th summit in Goa with BRICS–BIMSTEC outreach. 2012 had the 4th New Delhi summit and 2021 the virtual 13th summit.

cae5962b2980b5.s: What did India and Germany sign in New Delhi in September 2026 regarding Ramsar wetlands?
o: A Joint Declaration of Intent on their conservation and 'wise use'
A bilateral treaty on transboundary wetlands
An agreement to place Indian sites on the Montreux Record
A Memorandum of Understanding on wetland carbon credits
cae5962b2980b5.x: India and Germany signed a Joint Declaration of Intent on the conservation and 'wise use' of Ramsar wetlands.

cadf7ec9ad8563.s: In the context of the 26th SCO Summit, which pair is correctly matched?
o: SCO Civilisation Dialogue Forum – Mountain named by Kyrgyzstan
SCO Development Bank – To be hosted by India later in 2026
Lahore – SCO Tourism and Cultural Capital 2026–27
SCO Peak – SCO Tourism and Cultural Capital 2026–27
cadf7ec9ad8563.x: Lahore is the SCO Tourism and Cultural Capital 2026–27. India will host the Civilisation Dialogue Forum and Kyrgyzstan named a mountain SCO Peak.

cae5ddba43ee3d.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Shanghai Five included Uzbekistan.
2. The SCO was founded in Beijing in 2001.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cae5ddba43ee3d.x: Both are wrong: the Shanghai Five were China, Russia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan, and the SCO was founded in Shanghai in 2001 with Uzbekistan.

ca7413555e0566.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. India hosted the launch of OneSCD at the 81st UNGA in New York.
2. India's National Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Mission was launched in 2023 with a target of 2047.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca7413555e0566.x: Only 2 is correct. The OneSCD launch was hosted by Nigeria, with India as co-host.

ca90584702a252.s: With reference to the Indus Waters Treaty, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Institution that brokered the treaty – United Nations
Drainage of the Indus River – Bay of Bengal
ca90584702a252.x: The treaty was signed on September 19, 1960 at Karachi, brokered by the World Bank; the Indus drains into the Arabian Sea.

ca10e430537f83.s: Which statement about the India–Middle East–Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) is correct?
o: Eastern corridor: India–Arabian Gulf; Northern corridor: Europe–Canada; digital links only
Eastern corridor: India–Europe; Northern corridor: Arabian Gulf–Canada; rail only
Eastern corridor: Canada–Arabian Gulf; Northern corridor: India–Europe; shipping and electricity only
Eastern corridor: India–Arabian Gulf; Northern corridor: Arabian Gulf–Europe; rail, shipping, electricity, digital links and clean hydrogen
ca10e430537f83.x: IMEC's Eastern corridor links India with the Arabian Gulf and its Northern corridor links the Gulf with Europe, using rail, shipping, electricity, digital links and clean hydrogen.

ca610768de4fe1.s: The Act extended Iran sanctions by five years, up to:
ca610768de4fe1.x: The Iran sanctions were extended by five years to 2031.

cad3b718c3ac70.s: Which of the following about India's approved electricity exports to Nepal is NOT correct?
o: Exports were approved for 18 hours per day.
The total approved capacity is up to 654 MW.
Up to 600 MW can flow through the Muzaffarpur–Dhalkebar 400 kV line.
The arrangement runs from September 13 to December 31, 2027.
cad3b718c3ac70.x: The approved period ends on December 31, 2026, not 2027; the 18 hours/day, 654 MW and 600 MW figures are correct.

caf07fc1733a65.s:
With reference to India–Vietnam ties, consider the following statements:
1. 2027 was designated the Year of India–Vietnam Friendship.
2. The two countries set a trade target of USD 25 billion by 2030.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caf07fc1733a65.x: Both are correct: 2027 is the Year of India–Vietnam Friendship and the trade target is USD 25 billion by 2030.

caebc74027d329.s: Marking 75 years of India–Japan ties, 2027 has been designated as the:
caebc74027d329.x: 2027 is the India–Japan Year of Shared Horizons, marking 75 years of ties since 1952.

ca5f41112f1fd2.s: Which of the following about Italy's 2026 school policy on full-face coverings is NOT correct?
o: It bans full-face coverings in schools.
Foreign students lacking Italian are limited to 30% of first-year classes.
ca5f41112f1fd2.x: The fines range from €200 to €1,000, not €100 to €500.

cab17d2369d84b.s: In the context of India–Belgium cooperation, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Green ammonia project – Link between imec and India
cab17d2369d84b.x: Zorawar is a light tank. The green ammonia project is linked to Kakinada and semiconductor cooperation to linking imec with India.

caffc3c6f5828c.s:
With reference to India–Italy relations, consider the following statements:
1. Italy established diplomatic ties with India in 1948.
2. India and Italy established a Strategic Partnership in 2023.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caffc3c6f5828c.x: Only 2 is correct: the Strategic Partnership dates to 2023. Diplomatic ties were set up in 1947, not 1948.

ca3822690f4f05.s: Who co-chaired the 19th India–Vietnam Joint Commission Meeting in New Delhi in September 2026?
o: S. Jaishankar and Le Hoai Trung
S. Jaishankar and Bui Thanh Son
Rajnath Singh and Le Hoai Trung
ca3822690f4f05.x: The meeting was co-chaired by S. Jaishankar and Vietnamese Foreign Minister Le Hoai Trung; To Lam is Vietnam's President.

ca706ff648cc71.s: Which pair (India–Vietnam milestone – year) is correctly matched?
ca706ff648cc71.x: The Comprehensive Strategic Partnership came in 2016; diplomatic ties began in 1972, the Strategic Partnership in 2007 and the Enhanced CSP in 2026.

ca9d25e68c980d.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. ISRO invited proposals in 2021 for a 100-watt Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generator.
2. NASA invited ISRO to its Mars Base programme.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca9d25e68c980d.x: Only 1 is correct: ISRO sought proposals for a 100-watt RTG in 2021. NASA invited ISRO to its Moon Base programme, not a Mars Base.

cab889ed6ad6d6.s: In the context of additive manufacturing, which pair is correctly matched?
cab889ed6ad6d6.x: Agnikul Cosmos is IIT Madras incubated. Agnibaan SOrTeD flew in May 2024 and the Indian Army 3D-printed dwelling is at Ahmedabad.

ca278c2b358b3d.s:
With reference to TAPAS-1, consider the following statements:
1. It was scheduled for launch on a SpaceX Falcon 9 Transporter-18 rideshare from California.
2. It was planned for a 500-km sun-synchronous orbit with a life of 3 years.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca278c2b358b3d.x: Both are correct: TAPAS-1 was set for the Falcon 9 Transporter-18 rideshare and a 500-km SSO with a 3-year life.

ca3da5afc7a1ac.s: With reference to TakeMe2Space's orbital data-centre mission, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Mission target – By the end of 2026
Launch-services partner – French firm RIDE! Space
Orbital data centre – Stores sensor data for processing on the ground
ca3da5afc7a1ac.x: French firm RIDE! Space is the launch-services partner. The mission targets end-2028 with 6 satellites, and the data centre processes sensor data in orbit.

caaeb7a6b1f905.s:
With reference to Telangana's data-centre plans, consider the following statements:
1. Telangana has targeted 5 GW of hyperscale data-centre capacity by 2030.
2. The 5 GW goal is linked to an approximately USD 30 billion AI and digital investment opportunity.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caaeb7a6b1f905.x: Only 2 is correct. Telangana's 5 GW target is for 2029, not 2030.

caebf09bb4f26f.s:
With reference to GalaxEye, consider the following statements:
1. It became the first Indian start-up with a French patent for satellite-imaging technology.
2. Its OptoSAR system synchronises optical and SAR sensors to image simultaneously.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caebf09bb4f26f.x: Only 2 is correct. GalaxEye received a US patent, not a French one.

caeac9c77ac1aa.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The foxtail millet gene was inserted only into Pusa Basmati rice.
2. The SPROUT facility was inaugurated at BRIC–NIPGR, New Delhi, in September 2026.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caeac9c77ac1aa.x: Only 2 is correct. The foxtail millet gene was put into Pusa Basmati, Sona Masuri and IR-64.

caff411ab17f03.s: With reference to the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Ground stations – New Mexico, Chile and Japan
Nancy Grace Roman – NASA's first woman astronaut
caff411ab17f03.x: The Wide Field Instrument is a 300-megapixel infrared camera. Ground stations are in New Mexico, Australia and Japan, Roman was NASA's first Chief Astronomer, and dark energy is 68%.

ca5ddb341c9f97.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Agnikul Cosmos was established in 2017 and developed the small-satellite launcher Agnibaan.
2. A semi-cryogenic engine uses liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca5ddb341c9f97.x: Only 1 is correct. A semi-cryogenic engine uses refined hydrocarbon fuel with liquid oxygen; liquid hydrogen with liquid oxygen is a cryogenic engine.

ca9516d86596bd.s:
With reference to DRDO's indigenous High-Altitude Platform System, consider the following statements:
1. It reached an altitude of 20 km.
2. It uses solar power and hydrogen.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca9516d86596bd.x: Both are wrong: the platform reached 21 km (staying stable at 20 km for over 30 minutes) and uses solar power and helium, not hydrogen.

ca36910ef01c06.s: With reference to the BrahMos missile system, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Development partnership – HAL and NPO Mashinostroyenia
ca36910ef01c06.x: The contract falls under Buy (Indian–IDDM). The name combines Brahmaputra and Moskva, the partners are DRDO and NPO Mashinostroyenia, and the Philippines was the first foreign buyer.

ca6cb2cd2f12f8.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. GalaxEye was established in 2022 in Bengaluru.
2. Synthetic Aperture Radar is a passive remote-sensing system that cannot operate through clouds or at night.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca6cb2cd2f12f8.x: Both are wrong: GalaxEye was set up in 2021, and SAR is active remote sensing that works through clouds and at night.

caf88c6eef306d.s: Who launched INS Surya (FSS-1), India's first indigenous Fleet Support Ship, at Hindustan Shipyard Ltd, Visakhapatnam, on 6 October 2026?
o: The Chief of the Naval Staff
caf88c6eef306d.x: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh launched INS Surya at Hindustan Shipyard Ltd on 6 October 2026.

cad6e4190b620b.s:
With reference to Samarthak, consider the following statements:
1. It is the first of four Multi-Purpose Vessels being built for the Navy.
2. Its roles include surveillance, patrol, target deployment and support for unmanned systems.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cad6e4190b620b.x: Both are correct: Samarthak is the first of four MPVs, with surveillance, patrol, target-deployment and unmanned-support roles.

ca1161937231b0.s:
Assertion (A): TROUT is the first indigenous military-grade underwater ROV delivered to the Indian Navy.
Reason (R): EyeROV has delivered all 5 TROUTs ordered by the Navy.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ca1161937231b0.x: A is true: TROUT is the first indigenous military-grade underwater ROV for the Navy. R is false: EyeROV delivered 2 of the 5 ordered.

ca786a6b1d94ee.s: Which feature of the NDLI-FERMI AI Tutor launched at IIT Kharagpur lets users interact by scanning content?
ca786a6b1d94ee.x: The NDLI-FERMI AI Tutor, integrated with the National Digital Library of India, has the 'Scan & Ask' feature.

cad168e944405e.s: With reference to Hindustan Shipyard Ltd (HSL), which pair is correctly matched?
o: Jala Usha – Five Fleet Support Ships of about 43,500 tonnes
Vizag maritime hub – First ship built in independent India
cad168e944405e.x: HSL was established in 1941. Jala Usha (1948) was the first ship built in independent India, and the FSS programme covers five ships of about 43,500 tonnes.

ca597851492661.s: Who was the first Indian woman to summit Mount Everest?
ca597851492661.x: Bachendri Pal became the first Indian woman to summit Everest on 23 May 1984.

cacfcb2cfb0cfe.s: With reference to AIME-2026, the 2nd ASEAN–India Maritime Exercise, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Exercise sequence – Sea phase followed by Harbour phase
Indian ships – INS Sahyadri and INS Kulish
cacfcb2cfb0cfe.x: India sent INS Sahyadri and INS Kulish. The exercise ran Harbour phase then Sea phase, and ASEAN is headquartered at Jakarta.

cac8da3e5ee045.s:
With reference to KAZIND-2026, consider the following statements:
1. The 60-member Indian contingent was drawn mainly from the Garhwal Rifles and the Indian Air Force.
2. Kazakhstan's capital is Almaty.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cac8da3e5ee045.x: Only 1 is correct. Kazakhstan's capital is Astana, not Almaty.

ca2c33ffba3b0a.s:
With reference to Tarang Shakti-2026, consider the following statements:
1. The first edition of Tarang Shakti was held in 2025.
2. The exercise involved aircraft from 8 countries and 32 observers.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca2c33ffba3b0a.x: Only 2 is correct. The first edition of Tarang Shakti was held in 2024.

ca50ec35d0bc61.s: Which of the following pairs (exercise – venue) is correctly matched?
ca50ec35d0bc61.x: ReSAREX-26 was held off Mumbai. Varuna-2026 was at Toulon, Samudra Laksamana at Lumut and the CSC TTX at Eastern Naval Command, Visakhapatnam.

ca947b5d464b03.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Dharma Guardian is an India–Japan naval exercise.
2. JIMEX is an India–Japan army exercise.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca947b5d464b03.x: Both are wrong: Dharma Guardian is an India–Japan army exercise and JIMEX is the naval exercise.

caadf23615f30a.s:
With reference to India–France space agreements, consider the following statements:
1. They followed Emmanuel Macron's India visit in February 2026.
2. India–France space ties began in the 1970s and cover only civilian satellites.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caadf23615f30a.x: Only 1 is correct. India–France space ties date from the 1960s and also include human spaceflight.

cacd5f7cb55e01.s: Who announced the Indian Army's 'SAMARTH' vision?
cacd5f7cb55e01.x: General Dhiraj Seth announced the Army's SAMARTH vision; the President is the Supreme Commander.

ca89897d17e114.s: Who is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Army?
ca89897d17e114.x: The President of India is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Army.

cab42068bec516.s: With reference to the 10th India Mobile Congress 2026, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Theme – Srishti, Samvardhan, Sashakt and Suraksha
cab42068bec516.x: IMC 2026 was organised by DoT and COAI; its theme was 'Scale Without Boundaries' and COAI was set up in 1995.

ca1e858d690179.s: Cybertech Asia 2027, the first Cybertech Asia event in India, will be held at:
ca1e858d690179.x: Cybertech Asia 2027 is scheduled for 17–18 March 2027 at the Jio World Convention Centre, BKC, Mumbai.

ca53e32d786610.s:
With reference to India and GCAP, consider the following statements:
1. India became a member and co-developer of GCAP in August 2026.
2. India continues its own fifth-generation AMCA fighter programme.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca53e32d786610.x: Only 2 is correct. India received Dialogue Partner status in GCAP, not membership or co-developer status.

ca95bff34f7815.s:
With reference to the National Supercomputing Mission, consider the following statements:
1. As of September 2026, it had 40 supercomputers with a combined capacity of 68 petaFLOPS.
2. It was launched in April 2015.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca95bff34f7815.x: Both are correct: 40 systems with 68 petaFLOPS as of September 2026, and the Mission dates to April 2015.

ca88592adfb86f.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. IIT Hyderabad and Mie University signed MoUs on student and faculty exchange and semiconductor research.
2. The India Semiconductor Mission was launched in 2021 under MeitY.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca88592adfb86f.x: Both are correct: the IIT Hyderabad–Mie MoUs cover exchanges and semiconductor research, and ISM dates to 2021 under MeitY.

cac7721edcd91a.s:
With reference to the National Supercomputing Mission, consider the following statements:
1. Its build approach progressed from manufacturing to assembly and then to design and manufacturing.
2. The National Knowledge Network designed the Rudra servers.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cac7721edcd91a.x: Both are wrong: the progression was Assembly → Manufacturing → Design & manufacturing, and C-DAC designed the Rudra servers; NKN was the backbone.

caeb4509b916f4.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Lisbon is the capital of Portugal.
2. IIT Kharagpur was established in 1952.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caeb4509b916f4.x: Only 1 is correct. IIT Kharagpur was established in 1951.

cac80a0bffa73f.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. IIT Madras estimated that reuse could reduce rocket manufacturing cost by up to 80%.
2. The Stage Testing and Inspection Facility manufactures high-pressure propellant and pressurant tanks.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cac80a0bffa73f.x: Only 1 is correct. The Stage Testing and Inspection Facility tests recovered components; tanks are handled by a separate facility.

ca2719ab44e938.s: Which planet was confirmed on September 17, 2026 as the youngest known planet, less than 1 million years old?
ca2719ab44e938.x: Elias 2-24 b, a Jupiter-like gas giant orbiting the young star Elias 2-24, was confirmed as the youngest known planet.

ca45e40d0b7166.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Bio-Nivesh was launched by Dr. Jitendra Singh to link biotech start-ups with investors.
2. MatsyaMetri measures fish length by touching the fish directly.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca45e40d0b7166.x: Only 1 is correct. MatsyaMetri uses Augmented Reality (Google ARCore) to measure fish without touching them.

ca507e72c6e608.s:
With reference to GSLV Mk II, consider the following statements:
1. It can place about 2,250 kg into GTO and 6,000 kg into LEO.
2. Its indigenous cryogenic stage was introduced from GSLV-D5 in January 2014.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca507e72c6e608.x: Both are correct: about 2,250 kg to GTO and 6,000 kg to LEO, with the indigenous cryogenic stage from GSLV-D5 (January 2014).

caf747db5ecdb9.s: Which statement about Semicon 2.0 incentives is correct?
o: Notified on January 14, 2025; ISRO is nodal organisation and IITM the implementing agency
Notified in December 2021; Ministry of Earth Sciences is nodal ministry and IMD the implementing agency
Notified on August 31, 2026; MeitY is nodal ministry and ISM the implementing agency
Notified in February 2026; Ministry of Finance is nodal ministry and NCMRWF the implementing agency
caf747db5ecdb9.x: Semicon 2.0 incentives were notified on August 31, 2026, with MeitY as nodal ministry and ISM as implementing agency.

ca89051f389059.s: With reference to the Technology Translation Research Parks, which pair is correctly matched?
ca89051f389059.x: IIT Kanpur handles cybersecurity; IISc covers robotics and AI, IIT (ISM) Dhanbad mining and IIT Indore digital healthcare.

ca90513bc2db30.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. ICGS Subhadra Kumari Chauhan was decommissioned at Mumbai on August 27, 2026.
2. The name Meera Behn refers to the poet who wrote 'Jhansi Ki Rani'.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca90513bc2db30.x: Only 1 is correct. Meera Behn was Madeleine Slade; 'Jhansi Ki Rani' was written by Subhadra Kumari Chauhan.

ca278de534471a.s: With reference to the drought-tolerant rice research, which pair is correctly matched?
o: States receiving free seed – Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu
Dr. M. Muthamilarasan – Leader of the research
ca278de534471a.x: Dr. M. Muthamilarasan led the research. Assistance was ₹80 lakh, seed went to AP, Karnataka, Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu, and foxtail millet is Setaria italica.

ca8973381c9c1c.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. IIT Madras was established in 1959 with West German aid.
2. IIT-BHU received IIT status in 2011.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca8973381c9c1c.x: Only 1 is correct. IIT-BHU received IIT status in 2012.

ca8097f45bb798.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. A geosynchronous orbit is necessarily circular, equatorial and of zero inclination.
2. India has 30 GEO satellites.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca8097f45bb798.x: Both are wrong: a geosynchronous orbit can be elliptical or inclined (the description fits a geostationary orbit), and India has 31 GEO satellites.

ca476e176973b5.s: With reference to IAF No. 17 Squadron 'Golden Arrows', which pair is correctly matched?
ca476e176973b5.x: Vampire jets came in 1955. The squadron began with 12 Harvard-II Bs, now flies Rafales, and took part in Operation Sindoor in May 2025.

ca8e6ddc92550c.s:
Assertion (A): The SHANTI Act enables small modular reactors and fusion reactors.
Reason (R): The SHANTI Act enables small modular reactors and micro reactors.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ca8e6ddc92550c.x: A is false and R is true: the SHANTI Act enables small modular reactors and micro reactors, not fusion reactors.
